reference_audio.note: 3-10 s recommended.  Clips over 20 s are trimmed at the largest silence gap and cloning quality degrades.  If reference_text is omitted, the clip is auto-transcribed with Whisper.

parameters.name: audio_base64
parameters.description: Reference voice sample (3-10 s recommended) as a base64 string. Any container soundfile can decode (WAV, MP3, OGG, FLAC, ...). Clips over 20 s are trimmed at the largest silence gap.

parameters.name: reference_text
parameters.description: Exact transcript of the reference audio.  If omitted, the reference is auto-transcribed with Whisper ASR (the first such request pays a one-time ASR model load, which can be slow).

parameters.name: language
parameters.description: Two-letter language code, e.g. 'en' or 'fr'.  Omitted or empty defaults to 'en'.

parameters.name: seed
parameters.description: Random seed for reproducibility.  If omitted, a random seed in [1, 1000] is chosen and echoed in the response.

parameters.name: num_steps
parameters.description: Flow-matching sampling steps.  32 is the engine default; 16 is a reasonable fast/quality trade-off.

parameters.name: denoise
parameters.description: Prepend the denoise token (recommended when the reference clip has background noise).
